from deepvoice3_pytorch import builder as _builder

def _build():
    # The repository's builder makes the encoder, decoder and converter; the classes
    # of this file (MultiSpeakerTTSModel, AttentionSeq2Seq) put them together.
    parts = _builder.deepvoice3(n_vocab=50, embed_dim=16, encoder_channels=16, decoder_channels=16, converter_channels=16)
    model = MultiSpeakerTTSModel(AttentionSeq2Seq(parts.seq2seq.encoder, parts.seq2seq.decoder), parts.postnet, padding_idx=0, mel_dim=80, linear_dim=513, n_speakers=1, speaker_embed_dim=16, use_decoder_state_for_postnet_input=True)
    # Inference (no mel targets): teacher forcing views a non-contiguous tensor on current PyTorch.
    model.seq2seq.decoder.max_decoder_steps = 8
    return model
